laws.rule: Kruger National Park daily conservation fee, 1 November 2026 to 31 October 2027: international visitors R692 adult (12+), R345 child (2 to 11); SADC nationals R296 and R147. (No RBA rate for ZAR; at the South African Reserve Bank rate of 30 October 2026 crossed via the RBA USD rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = about 11.7177 ZAR: R692 ≈ A$59.06; R345 ≈ A$29.44; R296 ≈ A$25.26; R147 ≈ A$12.55)
